evalResult.overallSummary: Sprint 3 implementation is solid. The .adhd/ artifact commit system works correctly with [adhd]-prefixed commit messages and no-op on empty changes. evalResult.overallSummary: Sprint 4 is well-implemented. The notification system uses a clean, reusable `notify()` function with proper platform detection and graceful error handling. The --commit-adhd and --commit-adhd-logs flags are correctly parsed with proper implication logic. The commitAdhdMetadata function follows existing git patterns and includes correct file staging.
